name: code_gen
description: Short code-writing tasks scored with contains, regex, and JSON structural checks. References are the expected snippets.

cases.input:
id: palindrome
Write a Python snippet.
Return True when text reads the same forwards and backwards, ignoring case.

id: clamp
Write a Python snippet.
Clamp value into the closed interval from low to high.
cases.reference:
def clamp(value: float, low: float, high: float) -> float:
    return max(low, min(high, value))

cases.input:
id: parse_int
Write a Python snippet.
Parse text as an int. Return None when the text is not an integer.

id: dedupe
Write a Python snippet.
Drop duplicate strings and keep the first occurrence of each.
cases.reference:
def dedupe(items: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    return list(dict.fromkeys(items))

cases.input:
id: user_json
Write a Python snippet.
Return a JSON object with string fields name and email for Ada Lovelace, ada@example.com.

id: fizzbuzz
Write a Python snippet.
Build the FizzBuzz list from 1 through n. Multiples of 15 are FizzBuzz.

id: read_header
Write a Python snippet.
Read the first row of a CSV file and return it as a list of strings.

id: safe_div
Write a Python snippet.
Divide numerator by denominator. Return None when the denominator is 0.

id: slugify
Write a Python snippet.
Turn a title into a lowercase slug, with non-letters replaced by hyphens.

id: config_json
Write a Python snippet.
Return a JSON object with host 127.0.0.1 and integer port 8080.
